supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; holdout test R2 ~0.76-0.77 with X1,X2,X3.
Interaction coef 0.749, p=1.5e-18; holdout test R2 rises from ~0.77 (additive X1-X5) to ~0.877 with X4:X5; X1,X2,X3,X4:X5 alone gives 0.873 test R2, replicating out of sample.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant product term (p=1.5e-18), delta R2 0.07 in the pairwise model, and holdout test R2 improves by ~0.10 over the additive model.
